audience: South African online stores and shippers that book couriers with Bob Go

useCases.title: Compare courier prices for a parcel
useCases.text: Ask the couriers on the account for the rates of a parcel between two addresses. Use only the quotes with status success. Read a rate request that still waits for a courier.

useCases.title: Show the checkout shipping options for a cart
useCases.text: Get the shipping options a buyer sees at checkout, with the rules of the account applied. An empty result means no delivery to that area.

useCases.title: Book a shipment and confirm a courier accepted it
useCases.text: Book a shipment with a rate the user selected. The booking charges the account. Then read its submission status to confirm that a courier accepted it.

useCases.title: Print waybills and sticker labels
useCases.text: Generate the waybill PDF of shipments, or sticker labels as ZPL or PDF. Collect a queued label file when the batch is not ready yet.

useCases.title: Track a parcel and read its orders
useCases.text: Read every tracking checkpoint of a shipment by its tracking reference. List the orders of the account and read the fulfilments of one order.

useCases.title: Cancel a shipment after approval
useCases.text: Cancel a shipment by its Bob Go tracking reference when the user asks. Bob Go refuses the cancel once the courier has moved the parcel past collection.
